clauses.clause: Threat present: on every route ≥ 1 group or wanderer in the camera frame per 60 s of driving (tune; 11-01 strip showed 0 in frame for 30 s).
clauses.note: Fresh current-source six-route physical WASD matrix completes at both tiers with no skips or console/page errors. All37 original-size panels personally inspected, raw hashes verified and raw captures deleted. Wide first-threat frames show living blue humanoid infected/red bars beside or ahead of APC; close frames often crop contacts. Stills do not establish continuous coverage. Full archived observations recomputed by unchanged >=0.5m/s driving evaluator: low road10.7333/countryside14.75/shortcut14.3667s, high road15.4667/countryside18.8333/shortcut14.0667s conservative gaps, all <=60s. Dead bodies cannot reset interval; unknown intervals count fully and maximum sample interval is added. Five synthetic controls plus long-unknown and backwards-clock controls pass. Proof previously asserted a historical high-road failure; this non-invariant result assertion was removed, retaining actual occupied/driving clocks and all independent controls, with added current-source assertion. No producer, evaluator, threshold or game change; normal APC damage, protected courier.
